headline: Increased settlement authority in a lawsuit to $20,000, with a non-disclosure provision, 3-0.
summary: Commissioners met in executive session about a lawsuit, Docket No. 1:23-cv-00272. Members voted 3-0 to raise the authorized settlement amount to $20,000. Any settlement must include a non-disclosure provision, and members voted 3-0 to seal the minutes.
decisions: Approved increasing the authorized settlement amount to $20,000, with a non-disclosure provision if a settlement is reached, 3-0.
Approved a motion to seal the minutes of the executive session, 3-0.

decision_evidence.quote: A motion was made by Commissioner Kinch moved to increase the authorized settlement amount to $20,000. The motion was seconded by Vice Chairperson Torres. The motion further provided that, should a settlement be reached, the settlement agreement shall contain a non-disclosure provision.

A motion was made by Commissioner Kinch and seconded by Commissioner Torres to seal the minutes and vote according to R.I. General Laws Section 42-46-5(a)(1)(litigation Plaintiff v. Housing Authority of the City of Pawtucket et al Docket No. 1:23-cv-00272).

decision_titles: Sealing the minutes of the executive session

THE HOUSING AUTHORITY OF THE CITY OF PAWTUCKET 
 
 
BOARD OF COMMISSIONERS SPECIAL MEETING 
 
Fogarty Manor 
15th Floor Conference Room 
214 Roosevelt Avenue 
Pawtucket, RI 02860 
 
August 18, 2026, at 12:00 P.M. 
 
AGENDA MINUTES 
 
1. Meeting called to Order 
 
2. Roll Call 
 
3. Other Business 
 
a) Executive Session – Discussion and/or Approval and Vote on:  
1. R.I. General Laws Section 42-46-5(a)(1) 
(litigation Plaintiff v. Housing Authority of the City of 
Pawtucket et al Docket No. 1:23-cv-00272)  
 
4.  Adjournment - VOTE 
 
 
 
Next Meeting: Galego Court Community Room, Wednesday, September 9, 
2026, at 4 pm.
THE HOUSING AUTHORITY OF THE CITY OF PAWTUCKET 
 
 
 
The Meeting was called to order by Mary Bray, Chairperson of the Board at 12:02 pm 
with a motion made by Commissioner Torres and seconded by Commissioner Kinch. 
 
 
Upon roll call those present were as follows: 
 
 
 
Present                                                 
Mary Bray, Chairperson                                    
Olga Torres, Vice Chairperson                        
Henry Kinch, Sr., Commissioner                                                                                   
Joseph Brennan, Attorney                                
Justin Barros, Executive Director  
Tammy Cote, PHA Clerk            
 
 
 
Other Business 
  
 
 
a) Executive Session 
 
1. R.I. General Laws Section 42-46-5(a)(1)(litigation Plaintiff v. Housing Authority of 
the City of Pawtucket et al Docket No. 1:23-cv-00272)  
 
A motion was made by Commissioner Torres and seconded by Commissioner Kinch to 
go into executive session. Upon roll call the “Ayes and “Nays” were as follows: 
 
 
AYES        NAYS 
Mary Bray, Chairperson     
Olga Torres, Vice Chair 
Henry Kinch, Sr., Commissioner
THE HOUSING AUTHORITY OF THE CITY OF PAWTUCKET 
 
 
A motion was made by Commissioner Kinch moved to increase the authorized 
settlement amount to $20,000. The motion was seconded by Vice Chairperson Torres. 
The motion further provided that, should a settlement be reached, the settlement 
agreement shall contain a non-disclosure provision. Upon roll call the “Ayes and “Nays” 
were as follows: 
 
AYES        NAYS 
Mary Bray, Chairperson     
Olga Torres, Vice Chair 
Henry Kinch, Sr., Commissioner 
 
 
A motion was made by Commissioner Kinch and seconded by Commissioner Torres to 
seal the minutes and vote according to R.I. General Laws Section 42-46-
5(a)(1)(litigation Plaintiff v. Housing Authority of the City of Pawtucket et al Docket No. 
1:23-cv-00272).  Upon roll call the “Ayes and “Nays” were as follows: 
 
AYES        NAYS 
Mary Bray, Chairperson     
Olga Torres, Vice Chair 
Henry Kinch, Sr., Commissioner 
 
A motion was made by Commissioner Torres and seconded by Commissioner Kinch to 
exit the executive session. Upon roll call the “Ayes and “Nays” were as follows: 
 
AYES        NAYS 
Mary Bray, Chairperson     
Olga Torres, Vice Chair 
Henry Kinch, Sr., Commissioner 
 
 
A motion to adjourn the Board of Commissioners August 18, 2026, Special Meeting was 
made by Commissioner Torres and seconded by Commissioner Kinch.  
Upon roll call the “Ayes” and “Nays” were as follows: 
 
AYES        NAYS 
Mary Bray, Chairperson     
Olga Torres, Vice Chair 
Henry Kinch, Sr., Commissioner 
 
 
Adjournment – ended at 12:38 pm
